rationale: The volume profile is highly anomalous — one single 5-minute candle accounts for ~557,774 of the 559,370 shares traded today (essentially 7x the entire 80k-share float), yet price barely moved, suggesting a block cross or non-economic print rather than directional order flow. Already carrying a realized loss today, there is insufficient justification to commit capital here.
